title: Malicious code in statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.pwainsmortgage (npm)
description: The npm package statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.pwainsmortgage contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
